The rho reference is the matched negation-map rho arm every session runs beside every arm. gae_band is the B27 row (ic = ksum5-p, the cheapest k-sum arm there); every row's band is in the validator report (checks.rho_reference.gae_band_all_rows). rho_reference.binary_or_process: one ecbench binary, sha256 6c60b4c931294bf770039a5b47800e39c424eb2e7f4876b426cd084f7c364d77 (built at 3a9e85e644); every arm of a session runs in it
rho_reference.protocol: matched rho.negation reference arm (role reference) in every session, same curve, targets and algorithm seeds as every k-sum arm; curves with 2 usable automorphisms, so negation is the strongest symmetry available
rho_reference.unit: ecbench.gae (counted group operations, S = GAE/sqrt(r)); native work priced at w in {0, 0.1, 1} GAE per operation (AGENTS.md section 5a)
